name: app-fusion
description: Build one new mobile app from two or more legacy apps (native iOS, React Native, native Android), guided by the new app's Figma designs. Start with /app-fusion:fuse and get an inventory of every app, a capability map that shows what overlaps and what conflicts, the designs traced to every capability, the business rules of both codebases, the decisions only a person can make, and a phased plan you approve. The new app is then built capability by capability, with scripted proof that API calls, rules, strings, journeys and design copy still match. Includes a legacy write guard, a Figma call budget and cache, and a one-page report.

figmaCallBudget.title: Figma call budget
figmaCallBudget.description: Most Figma MCP read calls one fuse-design run may spend (whoami is free). Figma allows 600 a day on an Enterprise Dev or Full seat, 200 on Organization or Professional, and only 6 a month on View or Collab seats. Every response is cached, so a re-run costs nothing for what is already read.

guard.title: Legacy write guard
guard.description: Deny file edits under legacy/<app> (and the real folders the links point to), and ask before shell commands that would write there. Only active in a workspace with analysis/<program>/program.json.
